items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about Adolf Alexander Sr., did you ever play any of his arrangements? No, not Tats, but his father. [INTERVIEWEE] I didn't know his father.

ctx.x: He is some stock, but mostly specials.
